info.title: slnmap
info.description: Slnmap (sln-map) — a semantic map of your .sln for AI coding agents. Analyze a .NET solution into a queryable code graph, serve it over MCP, and inspect index status.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Slnmap — maps a .NET solution into a queryable code graph.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze a solution and build (or update) its code graph.

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Slnmap SQLite database. [default: slnmap.db]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the full, grouped warning breakdown instead of a single summary line. [default: False]

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: Path to the .sln or .csproj to analyze.

commands.name: analyze-ts
commands.description: Analyze a frontend project's HTTP call sites (via slnmap-ts) and merge them into the code graph.

options.name: --tsconfig
options.description: Path to the tsconfig.json to use (defaults to <frontend-root>/tsconfig.json).

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Slnmap SQLite database. [default: slnmap.db]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the full, grouped warning breakdown instead of a single summary line. [default: False]

arguments.name: FRONTEND_ROOT
arguments.description: Path to the frontend project's root directory.

commands.name: link
commands.description: Compute cross-stack edges between frontend HTTP call sites and their C# endpoints (cross-stack-linker-investigation.md).

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Slnmap SQLite database. [default: slnmap.db]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the full, grouped warning breakdown instead of a single summary line. [default: False]

options.name: --base-path
options.description: Prefix prepended to a frontend call site's own path before matching it against endpoints (e.g. "/api", matching an axios baseURL that isn't visible in the call site literal itself). Pass "" to disable — use when call sites already include the full path. [default: /api]

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Analyze once, then keep a warm workspace and re-analyze on every file save (near-instant on content changes).

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Slnmap SQLite database. [default: slnmap.db]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print the full, grouped warning breakdown instead of a single summary line. [default: False]

arguments.name: SOLUTION
arguments.description: Path to the .sln or .csproj to analyze.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Serve the code graph to MCP clients over stdio.

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Slnmap SQLite database. [default: slnmap.db]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show what is in the code graph database.

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Slnmap SQLite database. [default: slnmap.db]

commands.name: viz
commands.description: Export the code graph as a self-contained interactive HTML file.

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Slnmap SQLite database. [default: slnmap.db]

options.name: --output
options.description: Path of the HTML file to write. [default: graph.html]

options.name: --project
options.description: Export only this project's subtree; other projects appear as collapsed stubs.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check that the environment can run Slnmap (SDK, global.json, MSBuild, graph directory).

options.name: --db
options.description: Path to the Slnmap SQLite database. [default: slnmap.db]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Directory or solution to check for a governing global.json (defaults to the current directory). [default: <path>]
